raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17) stores txn_ts as DD/MM/YYYY strings, while all other rows are ISO. The min value, '16/01/2026', shows no slash-format value has a day below 16, so the day-first reading is unambiguous. Parsing slash-format values with strptime('%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') and keeping the ISO cast for the rest fixes the failure without changing columns or meaning.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '%/%' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
